segments.text: welcome to Agile Mania today we are
discussing on how to calculate capacity
and scrum capacity and scrum refers to
the team's available work hours for a
Sprint it helps teams plan their work
effectively and ensures they don't
overcommit calculating capacity is
crucial for Sprint planning and helps
teams set realistic expectations for
what they can deliver steps to calculate
capacity in scrum one identify the
Sprint
duration one a Sprint is usually 1 to 4
weeks long teams should confirm the
exact number of working days in the
Sprint two list all team members one
count the total number of people working
in the Sprint example if there are five
developers and two testers the team size
is seven three consider individual
availability one not everyone will be
available full-time due to vacations
meetings or other commitments two for
each team member subtract the
unavailable days from the total Sprint
days example if a team member is off for
2 days in a 10-day Sprint they are
available for8 days four calculate total
available hours one multiply each
member's available Days by their working
hours per day usually 6 to 8 hours
example if five developers each work 8
hours per day for 10 days their total
capacity is 5 * 10 * 8 = 400 hours five
adjust for Focus Factor one teams spend
time in meetings code reviews and
discussions so they are not 100%
productive two a typical Focus factor is
70 80% of total hours example if total
available hours are 400 then actual
capacity is 400 * 0.75 = 300 hours six
convert to story points optional one if
your team uses story points look at past
velocity Trends 300 hours divided by 50
story points equals 6 hours per story
Point use this to estimate how many
story points can be completed in the
upcoming Sprint wide capacity planning
matters in scrum one prevents overc
commitment by ensuring the team takes on
a realistic workload two improves Sprint
Planning by providing a clear
understanding of available effort three
enhances predictability for better
project planning and delivery by
following these steps scrum teams can
accurately estimate their capacity and
deliver highquality work without burnout
